verdict.rationale: Sprinto has its own docs page titled "Selecting an Audit Partner" under its Audits section, and it lets users collaborate with their auditor in-platform. That points to a first-party way to pick an auditor through the product, but the pack gives only the page title, with no detail on the network or booking flow. missing for 10: evidence of a vetted auditor network or in-house audit arm, a documented booking flow, published audit timeline expectations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can book the audit itself through the vendor — a vetted auditor network or in-house audit arm with published expectations on timeline

citations.quote: work cross-functionally with your team and auditor in-platform
